assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original cinematic background image for the APCE / Ateu Cast live broadcast preparation and closing screens, 16:9 widescreen, ideally 1920x1080. Create an art-directed, visually striking orbital observatory installation in an elegant dark architectural gallery. On the RIGHT HALF, a large sculptural arrangement of intersecting thin graphite-metal orbital rings, one flowing luminous dusty coral-pink ribbon (#EF4D63), a matte dark sphere, and a warm pale beige stone crescent/plinth (#E6D3CB). The architectural setting subtly recalls Brazilian modernist pilotis and a science museum, abstract rather than a recognizable building. Moody charcoal (#3B3C46) and near-black environment, refined cinematic side light, beautiful physically plausible materials, subtle atmospheric dust and very restrained film texture. Sophisticated, youthful, editorial and contemporary; polished 3D art direction with strong depth and sculptural silhouettes. IMPORTANT COMPOSITION: keep the LEFT 52 percent mostly quiet, dark, uncluttered negative space for a separately placed program logo and large broadcast typography. Main orbital artwork lives on the right from 55% to 96% width; leave 6% safe margins. The image is a BACKGROUND ONLY: absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO badges, NO people, NO camera frames, NO UI, NO microphones, NO yellow/red legacy badges, NO blue/purple cyberpunk lights, NO watermark. Existing official logos will be composited in HTML separately; do not draw or invent a logo.
